prompt:
Use case: strong style-transfer from ACTUAL PROJECT GEM ICONS.
Redraw the youthful leaf girl in IMAGE1 in the painting style of IMAGES2 and 3. The user explicitly rejected the previous generic clean anime/cartoon rendition. The PRIMARY stylistic authority is the ACTUAL GEM ICONS, not an anime portrait.

IMAGE1 gives only identity/costume/pose: green bob with chunky fringe, TWO huge sprout leaves above head, long leaf-shaped side locks tied with white pom-poms, violet eyes and gentle happy expression, black/gold front tabard over green skirt, white cross collar, oversized white billowing scalloped sleeves, red ties, opaque white leg coverings and small red shoes. Preserve youthful wholesome chibi identity and all clothing coverage. Both arms open and one knee lightly bent as the source, coherent anatomy, full feet/hands visible.
IMAGES2/3 give how to PAINT forms: thick deep-ink contour, hefty sculptural masses, a small number of confident angular planar light/shadow breaks, strong darker side faces and lighter upper faces, saturated controlled color, sparse broad gouache brushwork. Borrow the gem-icons' simple volume construction, not the shape of a gourd/shield or literal crystal material.

MAKE THE STYLE TRANSFER CLEAR:
Hair rebuilt as FOUR large rounded-angular green masses, each a broad yellow-green lit plane and deep leaf-green side plane, not smooth outlined anime locks. TWO top leaves each have only three broad painted faces explaining a substantial leaf volume, no fine veins.
White sleeves rebuilt as thick sculptural folded cloth volumes: one large ivory front face, one broad muted sage-gray side plane, one pale top plane. Scalloped edges simplified into a FEW broad lobe turns, mixing broad curves with decisive corners, no soft puffy outline-only cartoon.
Green skirt in 3–4 broad overlapping leaf-shaped planes with deep side shadows. White under-hem just a few wide sculpted folds, no numerous tiny ruffles. Black front tabard is one strong quiet dark mass with one SIMPLE dull-gold herbal leaf mark and clean gold edging; simplify rough original text to graphic motif.
Pom-poms are two simple rounded masses with a broad white plane and a single gray-green underside, not fuzzy spheres.
Hands/face retain gentle organic shape and simple warm skin tones; do NOT cover skin with tiny geometric shards. Simple violet cartoon eyes, one small highlight max, no intricate lashes/realistic iris. Red tie consists of one broad knot and two broad ribbon shapes, no strings or elaborate knots.
All forms must feel as solid, clear and intentionally painted as the reference gems. Use 3–5 LARGE value planes for the biggest masses, not hundreds of tiny triangles. Sparse wide brush passes only within planes, no grain/noise/speckling, no polygon mosaic, no smooth airbrush gradients, no glassy material, no vector-flat empty volumes.
Preserve green/ivory/black/gold/red palette; do not import blue from shield. No new items, gourd, backpack, staff, magic effects, sparkles or gemstones attached to character. Whole design still the source leaf girl.
One finished square full-body image with all leaves, sleeves and shoes safely inside, warm uniform ivory background. Remove gray source panel, star and sketchy border. No words, signature, frame, scenery or collage. The final must visibly share the PROJECT GEM ICON brush/volume language, not just generic cel-shaded cute anime.
